Upon killing

The Trickster with specific weapons or pickups that can instantly kill enemies, Toastie will appear in the bottom right corner of the screen for half a second before disappearing. In this brief timeframe, the player must quickly press the Down Arrow and Enter keys at the same time while Toastie is onscreen. The S key (the down key in the WASD configuration) does not count. On console pressing down on the "D-Pad" + "confirm button" (A for Switch and Xbox, X for PlayStation) should also work. Doing this unlocks Toastie as a playable character.
